# Court: the 7 x 4 tiled floor (top at z 0, 1.2 m tiles in dark grout), a stone border around it,
# and a colonnade on the west and the east sides. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Tile --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
material new Grout --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Stone --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
add mesh grid --name Floor --x-subdivisions 7 --y-subdivisions 4 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 8.4 4.8 1
apply --scale
material assign Grout
mode edit
select all
inset 0.08 --individual
material assign Tile
mode object
add mesh cube --name BorderN --size 1 --location 0.000 2.675 0.000
scale 9.500 0.550 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BorderS --size 1 --location 0.000 -2.675 0.000
scale 9.500 0.550 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BorderW --size 1 --location -4.475 0.000 0.000
scale 0.550 4.800 0.300
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name BorderE --size 1 --location 4.475 0.000 0.000
scale 0.550 4.800 0.300
apply --scale
select BorderN BorderS BorderW BorderE
active BorderN
join
rename BorderN Border
material assign Cap
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Stone
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name CW0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location -4.950 -2.400 0.9
add mesh cube --name BW0 --size 1 --location -4.950 -2.400 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KW0 --size 1 --location -4.950 -2.400 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CW1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location -4.950 -1.200 0.9
add mesh cube --name BW1 --size 1 --location -4.950 -1.200 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KW1 --size 1 --location -4.950 -1.200 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CW2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location -4.950 0.000 0.9
add mesh cube --name BW2 --size 1 --location -4.950 0.000 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KW2 --size 1 --location -4.950 0.000 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CW3 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location -4.950 1.200 0.9
add mesh cube --name BW3 --size 1 --location -4.950 1.200 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KW3 --size 1 --location -4.950 1.200 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CW4 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location -4.950 2.400 0.9
add mesh cube --name BW4 --size 1 --location -4.950 2.400 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KW4 --size 1 --location -4.950 2.400 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CE0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location 4.950 -2.400 0.9
add mesh cube --name BE0 --size 1 --location 4.950 -2.400 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KE0 --size 1 --location 4.950 -2.400 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CE1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location 4.950 -1.200 0.9
add mesh cube --name BE1 --size 1 --location 4.950 -1.200 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KE1 --size 1 --location 4.950 -1.200 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CE2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location 4.950 0.000 0.9
add mesh cube --name BE2 --size 1 --location 4.950 0.000 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KE2 --size 1 --location 4.950 0.000 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CE3 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location 4.950 1.200 0.9
add mesh cube --name BE3 --size 1 --location 4.950 1.200 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KE3 --size 1 --location 4.950 1.200 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name CE4 --vertices 8 --radius 0.2 --depth 1.5 --location 4.950 2.400 0.9
add mesh cube --name BE4 --size 1 --location 4.950 2.400 0.230
scale 0.500 0.500 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cube --name KE4 --size 1 --location 4.950 2.400 1.740
scale 0.540 0.540 0.180
apply --scale
select CW0 BW0 KW0 CW1 BW1 KW1 CW2 BW2 KW2 CW3 BW3 KW3 CW4 BW4 KW4 CE0 BE0 KE0 CE1 BE1 KE1 CE2 BE2 KE2 CE3 BE3 KE3 CE4 BE4 KE4
active CW0
join
rename CW0 Colonnade
material assign Stone
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Cap
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Floor Border Colonnade
shade flat
export court.glb
